L. 91-375 (Postal Reorganization Act, Aug. 12, 1970) is held in full (84 Stat. 719). Sec. 13(a) directs that the Postmaster General appoint postmasters at offices of all classes in the competitive civil service by three methods, replacing EO 7421's procedure by which the Postmaster General recommends to the President and the Commission holds the examination (sec. 1(a)-(b)). Candidate end for the sec. 1 procedure: 1970-08-12 (enactment). The Act does not mention EO 7421 and does not list the Sec. 2 patron-residence rule or the Sec. 3-4 age rules, so whether every unit ended is not shown by this text; the ENDING reader must decide per unit, and a later general rule ends a command only if the source shows it extinguished that command.
